_comment: 10-tenant Zipf workload reference. Used by multi-tenant SPANN benchmarks running through TenantIndexManager + shared RocksDB.

index._comment_storage: share_db=true routes all tenants through one rocksdb_shared_0/ dir using TenantPrefixedKeyValueIO.

tenants._comment_split: Sizes are computed as N_i = round(total / (i^alpha * H_N)), then assigned contiguous slices of the base vectors. Set 'sizes' below to override the formula.
tenants._comment_sizes: Listed sizes were generated with alpha=1.0 over N=10. They sum to ~1.004M (rounding). Adjust the last tenant or rescale to land exactly on base_vector_count.

build._comment_layers: Layers=1 until the upstream layer>0 SelectHead bug is fixed (see checkpoint 009).

size_aware_overrides._comment: Clamp ReplicaCount to <= head_count/2, BKTKmeansK to <= head_count, and pick PostingPageLimit so postings fill ~1 page on average. Prevents long-tail tenants from being over-built (see Zipf analysis).

search._comment_queries_per_tenant: shared = same query set against every tenant (cheap). per-tenant = sample fresh queries from each tenant's slice.
